quarterly_data.quarter: Chung-Hsin Electric & Machinery IR presentation: 2026 investor conference (04-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Generator and data-room air-conditioning business: driven by telecom operators and international firms building IDC data rooms and AI R&D centers in Taiwan, the business is expected to grow 15% in 2026. Company: it can integrate power generation systems and air conditioning, and operators are already discussing modular data-room cooperation, now under benefit evaluation. Its permanent-magnet centrifugal chiller, with 30% energy-saving efficiency, has become a main product.

quarterly_data.figure: 2026 capex about NT$1.5-2.0 billion; capacity +15%-20% expected
